entries.speaker: Orso Hawker

entries.dialogueText: "Have a good evening."

entries.dialogueText: They stood up.

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Glad to hear that we're on the sam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to hear that we're on the same page, Mr. President. But I will have to insist on the private talk."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fair enough. Will you leave us, ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough. Will you leave us, gentlemen?"
entries.menuText: "Fair enough. Will you leave us, gentlemen?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian?""
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian?"
entries.menuText: "Lucian?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You know exactly what I think. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know exactly what I think. But if you both insist upon it, I will leave."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Then please do so, Mr. Galade.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then please do so, Mr. Galade."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian stood up as Orso gave him a..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian stood up as Orso gave him a smile. Heron paid his respects and left with Lucian, leaving me and Orso alone.

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""So, Mr. President...""
entries.dialogueText: "So, Mr. President..."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""If you stop the reform committee m..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you stop the reform committee meetings immediately and focus on the real threats, I will guarantee you, we will manage the reformists together."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""You must eliminate these threats b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must eliminate these threats both internal and external. An emergency act can help you do that. We cannot trust anyone in the administration either."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tell me more about the legal detai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more about the legal details of an emergency act."
entries.menuText: "Tell me more about the legal details of an emergency act."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How can we fight against these thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can we fight against these threats with an emergency decree?"
entries.menuText: "How can we fight against these threats with an emergency act?"

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""According to Article 58, if public..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to Article 58, if public security and order are seriously disturbed or endangered within the Republic of Sordland..."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""...the President of Sordland may m..."
entries.dialogueText: "...the President of Sordland may modify and suspend parts of Constitution, subject to confirmation by the Supreme Court, to determine the validity of the declaration of a state of emergency."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Which parts of the Constitution ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which parts of the Constitution can we modify or suspend?"
entries.menuText: "Which parts of the Constitution can we modify or suspend?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How can we effectively silence the..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can we effectively silence the opposition?"
entries.menuText: "How can we effectively silence the opposition?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can't the Assembly simply revoke i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't the Assembly simply revoke it?"
entries.menuText: "Can't the Assembly simply revoke it?"

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""That is kind of a grey area. The C..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is kind of a grey area. The Constitution states that..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. Sordland is in a crisis.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Sordland is in a crisis."
entries.menuText: "I agree. Sordland is in a crisis."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Yes, this is very serious.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, this is very serious."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""...no State shall, in the case of..."
entries.dialogueText: "...no State shall, in the case of National Emergency, modify or suspend the rights of freedom, defined in Article 100 of the Constitution, unless actually invaded, or in such imminent danger as will not admit of delay."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If we want to give the police more..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we want to give the police more authority, we might need to modify the rights of freedom too."
entries.menuText: "If we want to give the police more authority, we might need to modify the rights of freedom too."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Such imminent danger... That can d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such imminent danger... That can definitely be argued to be the case."
entries.menuText: "Such imminent danger... That can definitely be argued to be the case."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""That is correct. Current security..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is correct. Current security laws are limited because of the personal freedoms defined in Article 100. We may need to suspend some of the privacy laws which definitely conflicts with the Constitution..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But we are not under invasion.""
entries.dialogueText: "But we are not under invasion."
entries.menuText: "But we are not under invasion."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""However, the section where it stat..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the section where it states that 'actually invaded, or in such imminent danger as will not admit of delay' can be up to interpretation. We are definitely under such imminent danger because of Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Not to mention United Contana's su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention United Contana's support for a communist coup in Sordland as well as Frens Ricter's involvement with Arcasia, which is definitely connected to all of these problems."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""That is correct.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is correct."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""It can definitely be argued that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It can definitely be argued that we are under such imminent danger because of Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""And of course, that is up to the S..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, that is up to the Supreme Court to decide. So that is not a problem."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""You have the power to give more au..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have the power to give more authority to the police with their search warrants, suspicion- based arrests, detention without trials... as well as banning the threatening nations' citizens from entering Sordland."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We may need increased surveillance..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may need increased surveillance on our political rivals to find out about their connections and plots. Bringing unlimited detention would allow you to arrest people as necessary, such as Mr. Ricter."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What if the investigations cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if the investigations cannot find anything incriminating?"
entries.menuText: "What if the investigations cannot find anything incriminating?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He needs to be eliminated.""
entries.dialogueText: "He needs to be eliminated."
entries.menuText: "He needs to be eliminated."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That might be going a bit too far.""
entries.dialogueText: "That might be going a bit too far."
entries.menuText: "That might be going a bit too far."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I disagree. You already know about..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. You already know about the coup plots and foreign backed terrorists in Sordland. And a lot of these issues overlap with the reformist agenda of creating a weaker Constitution."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I suspect Frens Ricter is involved..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect Frens Ricter is involved with many of these organisations. He may even be working together with Rumburg. And they really do pose an existential threat to Sordland."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""The information that I gave you ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "The information that I gave you can be enough, depending on what parts of the Constitution you'll modify. In an emergency, anything is possible, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""The Supreme Court will support you..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Court will support your decisions."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I agree. In an emergency, anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. In an emergency, anything is possible, Mr. President..."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""According to the Constitution, onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Constitution, only the President and the Grand National Assembly can revoke the emergency after it is declared. That is correct."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""However, as long as your party is..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, as long as your party is in line, they will never have a majority to revoke it immediately. So, no. They cannot *simply* revoke it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Okay. Where do we begin?""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay. Where do we begin?"
entries.menuText: "Okay. Where do we begin?"

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""There are obvious connections betw..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are obvious connections between the Bludish separatists and Rumburg. And the separatists have clear connections to the Worker's Party of Bludia. They should be declared a national security threat and the party should be banned."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Red Youth must also be our target...."
entries.dialogueText: "Red Youth must also be our target. They are plotting a communist revolution in Sordland with clear funding from United Contana. And now they took to the streets after the death of Bernard Circas. There are already clashes and protests on the streets which must be dealt with before it gets out of hand."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""You can also justify an action aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can also justify an action against the Young Sords. After all, they started all this mess with the commies, *and* they killed a man right near the Maroon Palace. That can be considered a declaration of war against the state itself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""These Blud separatists have no pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "These Blud separatists have no place in Sordland. They will not be tolerated."
entries.menuText: "These Blud separatists have no place in Sordland. They will not be tolerated."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They will be our targets.""
entries.dialogueText: "They will be our targets."
entries.menuText: "They will be our targets."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't want to create problems wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to create problems with our Bludish citizens."
entries.menuText: "I don't want to create problems with our Bludish citizens."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is not enough evidence to co..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is not enough evidence to connect the separatists with the Worker's party."
entries.menuText: "There is not enough evidence to connect the separatists with the Worker's party."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""But they are already creating prob..."
entries.dialogueText: "But they are already creating problems for us. Most Bluds in Bergia are either ballsy enough to show their support for the separatists or they vote for the Worker's Party."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""But let's not forget about the soc..."
entries.dialogueText: "But let's not forget about the socialists."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Come on, Mr. President. We all kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Mr. President. We all know what they stand for. Bluds will be Bluds. They all want to establish their own country in Bergia."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Both organizations must be declare..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both organizations must be declared as national threats."
entries.menuText: "Both organizations must be declared as national threats."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I need to think about this.""
entries.dialogueText: "I need to think about this."
entries.menuText: "I need to think about this."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""They are an enemy of the state. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are an enemy of the state. The state must react."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""They are both enemies of the state.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are both enemies of the state."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I don't think there is much to thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think there is much to think."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""But let's talk about how we can de..."
entries.dialogueText: "But let's talk about how we can deal with them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry to interrupt, Mr. Hawker, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to interrupt, Mr. Hawker, but I won't be going ahead with this."
entries.menuText: "Sorry to interrupt, Mr. Hawker, but I won't be going ahead with this."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I thought you wanted to plan our m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you wanted to plan our move."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I just wanted to hear your plan. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wanted to hear your plan. And now I've heard it."
entries.menuText: "I just wanted to hear your plan. And now I've heard it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I cannot do this, Mr. Hawker.""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot do this, Mr. Hawker."
entries.menuText: "I cannot do this, Mr. Hawker."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I thought I wanted to. Instead I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought I wanted to. Instead I will be proceeding with the reforms."
entries.menuText: "I thought I wanted to. Instead I will be proceeding with the reforms."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""What is the meaning of this?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is the meaning of this?"

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""You will instead push on with your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will instead push on with your reforms then? It seems you are also part of the conspiracy, after all."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Is this all a joke to you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is this all a joke to you?"

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""It seems you are also part of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems you are also part of the conspiracy, after all."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We should eliminate the threats on..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should eliminate the threats on our streets first. The police should have the authority to disperse crowds as necessary. We also have to keep the streets clean from the socialist thugs and Bludish separatists."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We should give more authority to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should give more authority to the police regarding their use of force. They should be able to stop and frisk as necessary, especially in Bludish neighbourhoods."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""The police will also need permissi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police will also need permissions for increased surveillance against these organizations. They should be able to search properties without warrants, and wiretapping should be permissible beyond its current limits."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.
entries.menuText: Nod.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "We should suspend the right to protest and disperse the crowds."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The police should stop and frisk b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police should stop and frisk based on suspicion."
entries.menuText: "The police should stop and frisk based on suspicion."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""They will also need to be able to..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will also need to be able to act swiftly. If a person is suspected of crimes against the national security of Sordland, the police should be able to detain them without trial. We cannot allow them proper trials anyway."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree."
entries.menuText: "I agree."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."

entries.menuText: Nod.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think detention without trial is..."

entries.menuText: "I think detention without trial is too much."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We are fighting against national s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are fighting against national security threats here. These are terrorists. We need extreme measures in extreme situations."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""There are also the external threat..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are also the external threats we must face."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""And there are also the external th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And there are also the external threats we must face."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Rumburg has acted hostile in the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg has acted hostile in the past and now they are arming the Bluds. We must cut all ties with them. They need to be embargoed, their citizens must barred from entering Sordland."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""We must erase all of their influen..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must erase all of their influence in Sordland, weaken their trade and give them a message."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rumburg is our biggest enemy, we m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg is our biggest enemy, we must react."
entries.menuText: "Rumburg is our biggest enemy, we must react."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We shouldn't escalate the situatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shouldn't escalate the situation with Rumburg too fast."
entries.menuText: "We shouldn't escalate the situation with Rumburg too fast."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""They are the ones who are spitting..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are the ones who are spitting on us! They already escalated the situation."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""And of course, we need to prepare..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, we need to prepare our army in any case. They have a very powerful military, and they seem to have plans on our soil."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""Then there are the superpowers. Bo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then there are the superpowers. Both are influencing our nation to be in their spheres. It seems Arcasia already bought Mr. Ricter and possibly is behind all of this."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""And United Contana is funding Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: "And United Contana is funding Sordish communists against our state. But we cannot bow down to the superpowers. Sordland must stand tall."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't go against the superpower..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't go against the superpowers."
entries.menuText: "We can't go against the superpowers."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will not bow to them, Mr. Hawke..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will not bow to them, Mr. Hawker."
entries.menuText: "We will not bow to them, Mr. Hawker."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I know it is a serious issue. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it is a serious issue. But their actions against our country is obvious. We simply cannot allow them to manipulate us."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I know we won't. They tried to div..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know we won't. They tried to divide Sordland before, but we came out stronger after the Civil War."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "I salute Colonel Soll for that."
entries.menuText: "I salute Colonel Soll for that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will come out of this stronger..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will come out of this stronger again."
entries.menuText: "We will come out of this stronger again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree, but we cannot afford to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, but we cannot afford to sever all of our ties with them."
entries.menuText: "I agree, but we cannot afford to sever all of our ties with them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We might need one of their support..."
entries.dialogueText: "We might need one of their support against the other."
entries.menuText: "We might need one of their support against the other."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker

entries.dialogueText: "You should think about it further."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""May God preserve his soul.""
entries.dialogueText: "May God preserve his soul."

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: ""I do hope so, Mr. President. It wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope so, Mr. President. It will all be up to you."
